content.description: Parraton is a decentralized, permission-less, open-source yield optimization protocol on TON blockchain. Parraton belongs in TON DeFi because its main workflow gives users a way to trade, earn, borrow, stake, or manage liquidity through an actual product surface. Parraton gives TON users a practical path to deploy capital, route trades, manage liquidity, or interact with DeFi positions. Parraton is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
